    Who died in Grey's Anatomy season 22 spoilers?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    In the season 22 premiere of Grey's Anatomy (2025), pediatric surgeon Dr. Monica Beltran (played by Natalie Morales) dies following a catastrophic operating room explosion. Pinned by medical equipment, she dies of injuries after successfully guiding Dr. Jules Millin through a surgery to save a young patient. 
    This video shows a glimpse of the aftermath of the explosion in the season 22 premiere:
    02:09
    Entertainment Tonight
    YouTube• Oct 10, 2025
    Key Details Regarding the Season 22 Death: 
    • The Cause: Monica Beltran dies from internal bleeding after being crushed by machinery in the operating room during the blast
      .
    • Other Injuries: Atticus "Link" Lincoln was also injured in the explosion, almost died, and faces a long recovery.
    • The Reaction: Jules Millin is heavily affected, as Monica was her mentor, while Amelia Shepherd and the rest of the staff struggle with the loss, according to reports from GeekSided.
    • Behind the Scenes: Showrunner Meg Marinis decided to kill off the character to create a "memorable" and earned death, as noted in TheWrap. 
    The season 22 premiere dealt with the immediate aftermath of the explosion, which was a cliffhanger from the previous season, notes YouTube.
